stories.title: Sensex rallies as investor wealth grows
stories.summary: The BSE Sensex rose 2,009 points and the Nifty climbed 576 points, extending a six-day winning streak. The rally added Rs 8.11 lakh crore to market capitalisation in a single session, bringing the total to Rs 501.55 lakh crore. Investor wealth has increased by Rs 28.92 lakh crore recently.

stories.title: Dalal Street extends winning streak
stories.summary: Benchmark indices extended their winning streak to a sixth consecutive session on November 5. The Nifty closed above 24,500 for the first time since August 7, 2026. The gains followed a decline in crude oil prices and optimism regarding the US midterm election results and foreign fund inflows.

stories.title: Markets surge following US midterm results
stories.summary: The BSE Sensex rose 2,009 points and the Nifty surged 576 points on Thursday. The rally followed a decline in crude oil prices and investor optimism after the Democratic Party gained control of the US Congress. The Sensex closed at 79,310.01, marking its highest level in months.

stories.title: Sensex jumps over 2,000 points
stories.summary: The BSE Sensex climbed 2,008.61 points to close at 79,310.01, while the Nifty gained 576 points. The rally was attributed to falling crude oil prices, sustained foreign fund inflows, and market optimism following the US midterm elections. The indices reached their highest levels in three months.

stories.title: Market capitalisation crosses Rs 500 lakh crore
stories.summary: The Sensex rose 2,009 points to 79,310 and the Nifty gained 576 points to 24,537. The session added Rs 8 lakh crore to total market capitalisation, pushing it above Rs 500 lakh crore for the first time. Sectoral indices in auto and finance saw gains of 4 percent.

stories.title: Benchmarks reclaim August levels
stories.summary: The Sensex and Nifty extended their winning streak to six sessions, with the Sensex reclaiming its August 3 closing level. The surge added nearly Rs 8 lakh crore to market capitalisation in one day. Both benchmarks posted their largest single-day gains in seven months on Thursday.

stories.title: Sensex and Nifty post seven-month high gains
stories.summary: The Sensex and Nifty 50 climbed approximately 2.4 percent each on Thursday, marking their largest single-day gains in seven months. The rally was supported by falling crude oil prices and global sentiment following US midterm election results. Fourteen of 16 major sectoral indices ended in positive territory.

stories.title: Indian equity benchmarks sustain rally
stories.summary: Indian equity benchmarks extended their winning streak to a sixth consecutive session on Thursday. The Sensex rose 2,008.61 points to 79,310.01, while the Nifty 50 settled above 24,500. The gains were driven by falling crude oil prices and foreign investor buying, bringing indices near three-month highs.

stories.title: Sensex and Nifty rally for sixth day
stories.summary: The Nifty50 and Sensex have gained more than 7 percent over six consecutive trading sessions as of November 5. The indices navigated volatility and geopolitical shifts to reach these levels. Analysts are now speculating whether the Nifty will reach the 25,000 mark in the near term.

stories.title: Seoul shares drop on AI regulation fears
stories.summary: South Korean stocks fell 5.28 percent as the Democratic Party's victory in US midterm elections sparked concerns over potential AI investment regulations. The KOSPI index closed at 5,383.80 after a sell-side sidecar was activated to suspend program trading. The local currency also fell against the US dollar.

stories.title: Economist questions market reaction to US election
stories.summary: US stocks rose Wednesday after Democrats won control of Congress, with the Dow jumping 3 percent. Steven Blitz of GlobalData TS suggested investors may be overstating the impact of the result on fiscal expansion and policy. The market move reflected hopes that a divided Washington would limit changes.

stories.title: Tech stocks tumble as AI optimism cools
stories.summary: Tech firms fell on Thursday as investors reconsidered the AI boom following the US midterm elections. The sector faced pressure amid growing public concern over the rapid construction of data centres. While broader markets rallied on hopes of a policy shift, the tech sector remained cautious.

stories.title: Asian markets decline as chipmakers face sell-off
stories.summary: Asian shares mostly fell following the US midterms, with South Korea's Kospi dropping 3.5 percent. Heavy selling hit chipmakers, including Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. In Tokyo, shares in SoftBank Group and equipment makers Advantest and Tokyo Electron also declined as AI-related stocks extended their recent losses.

stories.title: RBI forms advisory panel for financial markets
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has established a Technical Consultative Committee for Financial Markets to strengthen oversight. The panel includes senior banking executives and industry specialists. The move aims to address emerging risks and support stability as market dynamics and regulatory requirements continue to evolve.

stories.title: Anaskar Flags CSR Misuse by Private Banks, Seeks RBI Probe
stories.summary: Vidyadhar V. Anaskar, Administrator, has approached the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), raising concerns over the alleged misuse of Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) funds by certain private sector banks to secure deposits from Zilla Parishads, Municipal Corporations, Municipal Councils and other government and semi-government institutions.

stories.title: SEBI reviews growth platform for innovation-led firms
stories.summary: SEBI has formed a working group to review the Innovators Growth Platform framework. The initiative aims to help start-ups and research-intensive sectors like semiconductors and space raise capital. The group will examine existing eligibility and listing requirements to better accommodate the financing needs of these businesses.

stories.title: SEBI issues warning to Bambino Agro over transactions
stories.summary: SEBI issued an administrative warning to Bambino Agro Industries for failing to obtain shareholder approval for material related party transactions. The regulator noted that promoter group votes were improperly counted during the approval process. The company has been told to improve its compliance standards.

stories.title: NPCI says merchants cannot pass on UPI charges
stories.summary: The NPCI has told the Supreme Court that merchants are barred from passing on new MDR charges to customers. The corporation maintains that the fees are necessary to sustain the UPI ecosystem, noting that 96 percent of person to merchant transactions will remain free. Fees are not optional.

stories.title: Street vendors may abandon UPI over MDR fees
stories.summary: An Indian School of Business survey of 722 street vendors found that 70 percent of respondents make supplier payments above the proposed MDR threshold. All surveyed vendors said they would switch to cash if suppliers passed these costs on to them. Digital progress is currently one surcharge away.

stories.title: Proposed UPI fees risk reversing digital payment adoption
stories.summary: A study by the Indian School of Business suggests that proposed merchant discount rate fees could push street vendors back to cash. Only 52 percent of vendors are aware of the upcoming rules. The research warns that high supplier fees risk reversing years of digital payment progress.

stories.summary: Indian travellers can now receive a 10 percent discount on eligible purchases at Dubai Duty Free when using UPI. The offer is capped at 100 UAE Dirhams and requires users to activate UPI International or Global services. Shopping is now officially a cross-border digital activity.

stories.title: Pine Labs to deploy 1 million soundboxes
stories.summary: Pine Labs plans to install 1 million soundboxes at existing merchant locations to capture missed UPI transactions. Management noted that rival devices currently capture up to 20 percent of payments at their own terminals. The company expects a 21 percent EBITDA margin despite the expanded hiring.

stories.title: OneStack raises 12.5 crore for cooperative bank UPI
stories.summary: Fintech provider OneStack has raised 12.5 crore in a round led by Shepherd’s Hill. The company plans to use the funds to integrate cooperative banks into the UPI network as direct issuers and acquirers. OneStack has now raised 45 crore across four funding rounds.

stories.title: NCERT introduces personal finance to Class 9 curriculum
stories.summary: The NCERT has added chapters on mutual funds, taxes, and entrepreneurship to the Class 9 Social Science textbook. The new material aims to teach students about budgeting and profit and loss accounts. Financial literacy is now a formal part of the school day.

stories.title: High Court limits tax department on capital gains
stories.summary: The Bombay High Court ruled that the Income Tax Department cannot add the entire purchase cost of a second flat to a taxpayer's income under Section 54F. The court found the department incorrectly computed gains by adding 4.78 crore to the taxpayer's income. Tax math is not absolute.

stories.title: Income tax rules for cash and gold holdings
stories.summary: Indian tax rules do not set a general upper limit on cash or precious metals kept at home. However, taxpayers must be able to explain the source of their assets. Section 186 limits cash receipts of 2 lakh or more in specific circumstances. Documentation is required.

stories.title: Dhanteras 2026 Date and Puja Timing with Income Tax Rules on Gold
stories.summary: Dhanteras is considered one of the auspicious festivals in India which will be celebrated on 6th November 2026. The festival is associated with wealth, prosperity, good health and happiness. In this auspicious occasion many families consider buying precious metals on this day a symbol of

stories.title: Gold loan market reaches 22.5 lakh crore
stories.summary: India's gold loan market has reached 22.5 lakh crore in outstanding balances as of August 2026. CIBIL data indicates that borrowers are increasingly returning for repeat loans and larger ticket sizes. The market has nearly tripled in size over the last three years.

stories.title: State-run banks maintain lower home loan rates
stories.summary: Public-sector banks offer floor rates starting at 7.25 per cent, maintaining a competitive edge for cost-conscious borrowers as of November 4, 2026. Data from Paisabazaar.com shows private lenders continue to operate at higher interest levels. The mortgage market remains a choice between interest rates and processing flexibility.

stories.title: HDFC Bank raises fixed deposit rates
stories.summary: HDFC Bank has increased interest rates on fixed deposits by up to 50 basis points for select tenures, effective November 4, 2026. Senior citizens can now earn up to 7.20 per cent, while general customers reach a maximum of 6.60 per cent. Rates are subject to maturity periods.

stories.title: Axis Bank announces festive vehicle loan offers
stories.summary: Axis Bank is offering 100 per cent financing on car loans with a 30-minute disbursal time ahead of Diwali. The scheme includes a 50 per cent reduction in processing fees and special pricing for electric vehicles. The bank is currently promoting these benefits across its retail banking products.

stories.title: PFRDA chairman suggests NPS for long-term retirement planning
stories.summary: PFRDA chairman Sivasubramanian Ramann claims the National Pension System may offer better long-term returns than mutual funds for those seeking retirement security. He cites tax exemptions and flexible investment schemes as primary advantages. Mutual fund investments are currently reaching record highs despite the regulatory preference for pension schemes.

stories.title: PFRDA targets 100 lakh crore NPS corpus by 2040
stories.summary: The PFRDA aims to grow its assets under management to 100 lakh crore by 2040, up from the current 18 lakh crore. Chairman S Ramann plans to leverage banks and the UPI ecosystem to accelerate adoption. The regulator is looking to move beyond organic growth to reach this target.

stories.title: Regulator plans UPI integration to boost pension adoption
stories.summary: The PFRDA intends to reach an asset under management of 100 lakh crore by 2040 by integrating the National Pension System with UPI and expanding bank distribution networks. The regulator also plans to include unlisted equity in its investment options. Digital inclusion is now a stated priority.
